simulation.method: Current tracked and non-ignored new working-tree bytes copied using read-only git ls-files and rsync; no .git directory; root/workspace node_modules symlinked from this checkout. No git init/commit/clone or other Git writes.

limits: The no-history copy shares installed dependencies; no fresh installation or actual GitHub Actions run.
Sandbox localhost listen EPERM failures are retained, not converted to passes/skips.
No external network, secret access, paid calls, deploys, image builds or other-worktree operations.
